stories.title: Top secrets come spilling out
stories.summary: A CNN opinion article examines the consequences of major secrets becoming public. It recalls the 1917 Zimmermann Telegram, in which Germany proposed unrestricted submarine warfare and sought Mexican support against the United States. Publication of the decoded message caused a sensation and helped propel the US into the First World War against Germany.

links.headline: Top secrets come spilling out
links.excerpt: In 1917, British analysts deciphered a coded message the German foreign minister sent to one of his country's diplomats vowing to begin "unrestricted submarine warfare" and seeking to win over Mexico with a promise to "reconquer the lost territory in Texas, New Mexico and Arizona" if the US entered the world war. When it became public, the Zimmerman Telegram caused a sensation, helping propel the US into the conflict against Germany.

stories.title: Trump Says He Wants to 'Clean Out' Gaza, Send Refugees to Egypt and Jordan
stories.summary: President Donald Trump proposed moving Palestinians from Gaza to Egypt and Jordan, either temporarily or for the longer term, according to the Wall Street Journal. He described the heavily bombed enclave as “a demolition site.” Arab countries have rejected such relocation proposals since the war began.

stories.title: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
stories.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un is promoting a “shock brigade” of 300,000 teenagers and people in their twenties drafted into flood reconstruction. The Wall Street Journal presents the effort as part of his attempt to keep young North Koreans in line. It says the government is also seeking to shut out the influence of Hollywood and K-pop.
